name: daymods
description: Small, independent mods for Claude Code. Install only the ones you want.

plugins.name: autoroute
plugins.description: Picks the model and effort per prompt, routes subagents to cheap models, and gates Fable and extra-usage spend.

plugins.name: box-tools
plugins.description: A Tools button at the right end of the prompt footer that opens a small box to switch the model, the effort and your daymods on or off.

plugins.name: pace-statusline
plugins.description: A 4-line status line with limit bars, reset times and a pace prediction that tells you if you'll run out before the reset. 6 themes.
